guarantees.claim: u_prim_buf_state_output_sel is instantiated and its output is connected to mux_sel_buf_output_logic, taking mux_sel as input.

assumptions.claim: The prim_sec_anchor_buf primitive correctly implements the logic integrity function implied by the SEC_CM comment.
assumptions.cond: when integrity of mux_sel is required
assumptions.risk: If the primitive has a flaw, mux_sel_buf_output_logic may carry a corrupted or glitch-prone version of mux_sel, bypassing security.

formal.consequent: u_prim_buf_state_output_sel behaves as per its specification

formal_sketch.antecedent: when integrity of mux_sel is required
formal_sketch.consequent: u_prim_buf_state_output_sel behaves as per its specification

assumptions.claim: The width of mux_sel matches the AppMuxWidth parameter used in the buffer instantiation.
assumptions.risk: Width mismatch could silently truncate or misconnect bits, leading to incorrect mux selection and potential security breaches.

uncertain_points.claim: The integrity protection of mux_sel depends entirely on the unseen implementation of prim_sec_anchor_buf; it is unknown whether it detects or tolerates faults.
uncertain_points.cond: when mux_sel toggles or is under attack
uncertain_points.risk: A fault could propagate to mux_sel_buf_output_logic without detection, leading to erroneous data or key selection.

formal_sketch.antecedent: when mux_sel toggles or is under attack
formal_sketch.consequent: The integrity protection of mux_sel depends entirely on the unseen implementation of prim_sec_anchor_buf; it is unknown whether it detects or tolerates faults

uncertain_points.claim: The instantiation shows no error/alert output from the buffer; if internal integrity checks exist, a fault may be uncontained.
uncertain_points.cond: when a mismatch or glitch occurs inside u_prim_buf_state_output_sel
uncertain_points.risk: Silent corruption of mux_sel_buf_output_logic, adverse to data/control integrity.
